import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.preprocessing import PolynomialFeatures

# Set random seed for reproducibility
np.random.seed(42)

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
print("Loading data...")
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv")

# Check data loading
print(f"Train shape: {train.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test.shape}")

# Separate features and target
y = train["target"].values
train_features = train.drop(["id", "target"], axis=1)
test_features = test.drop(["id"], axis=1)

# Identify numeric features (excluding f_27 which is high-cardinality categorical)
numeric_features = train_features.select_dtypes(include=[np.number]).columns.tolist()
categorical_features = ["f_27"]

# Convert categorical f_27
train_features["f_27"] = train_features["f_27"].astype("category").cat.codes
test_features["f_27"] = test_features["f_27"].astype("category").cat.codes

# Split training data into train/validation (stratified)
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    train_features, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
)

print(f"Train samples: {len(X_train)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(X_val)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_features)}")

# Create interaction features for numeric columns
# Use polynomial features with interaction terms (degree 2, includes_bias=False)
print("Creating interaction features...")
poly = PolynomialFeatures(degree=2, interaction_only=True, include_bias=False)
X_train_poly = poly.fit_transform(X_train[numeric_features].values)
X_val_poly = poly.transform(X_val[numeric_features].values)
X_test_poly = poly.transform(test_features[numeric_features].values)

# Combine with categorical features
X_train_combined = pd.DataFrame(
    X_train_poly, columns=[f"poly_{i}" for i in range(X_train_poly.shape[1])]
)
X_train_combined["f_27"] = X_train["f_27"].values
X_train_combined = X_train_combined.astype(
    {col: float for col in X_train_combined.columns if col != "f_27"}
)
X_train_combined["f_27"] = X_train_combined["f_27"].astype(float)

X_val_combined = pd.DataFrame(
    X_val_poly, columns=[f"poly_{i}" for i in range(X_val_poly.shape[1])]
)
X_val_combined["f_27"] = X_val["f_27"].values
X_val_combined = X_val_combined.astype(
    {col: float for col in X_val_combined.columns if col != "f_27"}
)
X_val_combined["f_27"] = X_val_combined["f_27"].astype(float)

X_test_combined = pd.DataFrame(
    X_test_poly, columns=[f"poly_{i}" for i in range(X_test_poly.shape[1])]
)
X_test_combined["f_27"] = test_features["f_27"].values
X_test_combined = X_test_combined.astype(
    {col: float for col in X_test_combined.columns if col != "f_27"}
)
X_test_combined["f_27"] = X_test_combined["f_27"].astype(float)

# Train LightGBM model
print("Training LightGBM model...")
params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.1,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_jobs": -1,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_train_combined.values, label=y_train, feature_name=list(X_train_combined.columns)
)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(
    X_val_combined.values,
    label=y_val,
    feature_name=list(X_val_combined.columns),
    reference=train_data,
)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=500,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(stopping_rounds=50), lgb.log_evaluation(0)],
)

# Evaluate on validation set
val_pred = model.predict(X_val_combined.values)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Make predictions on test set
test_pred = model.predict(X_test_combined.values)

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame({"id": test["id"], "target": test_pred})
submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Submission shape: {submission.shape}")
